postings.title: SLT Mechanical Design Intern
postings.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
Join Intel's System Level Test (SLT) team within the Technology Development organization as a Mechanical Design and Thermal Engineering Intern . The SLT team develops innovative test platforms and infrastructure that enable validation and high-volume manufacturing of Intel's leading-edge products.
In this role, you will collaborate with experienced engineers to design, analyze, and optimize mechanical and thermal solutions for complex test hardware and systems. You will contribute to the development of next-generation test platforms by supporting concept development, CAD design, thermal analysis, prototyping, laboratory validation, and system integration activities.
As a Mechanical Design and Thermal Engineering Intern, you will gain hands-on experience solving real-world engineering challenges related to structural design, cooling technologies, reliability, manufacturability, and system performance. You will help characterize and resolve mechanical and thermal issues through experimentation, data analysis, and engineering simulations while working closely with cross-functional teams across mechanical, thermal, electrical, manufacturing, and system engineering disciplines.
This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to technologies that directly impact Intel's product development and manufacturing success while building technical expertise in mechanical design, thermal management, and semiconductor test systems.
Key Responsibilities
Designs and develops mechanical devices, systems, equipment, and packaging, creating practical mechanical designs that incorporate design for manufacture, design for serviceability, and design for sustainability considerations.
Develops system concepts from scratch, creates product and test specification based on requirements, drives system integration, development, procurement, acceptance, and deployment to high volume manufacturing.
Creates mechanical customer guidance for appropriate use of the designs and resolves customer concerns.
Defines and conducts feasibility studies and develops and implements test plans and parameters for new and existing mechanical designs, including functionality validation, reliability, and safety.
Lists the mechanical properties of the designed products or parts within a product and validates unique mechanical and/or thermomechanical solutions and equipment.
Applies deep materials knowledge and mechanical expertise to select right materials, components, and manufacturing technologies for the system.
Coordinates with suppliers to incorporate manufacturing feedback, produce the designs, and resolve manufacturing issues.
Conducts design reviews and performs system acceptance tests working with customers, drives structural and stress analysis of the key mechanical components such as the chassis structure, heat sinks, and thermal attachment, prototypes testing, initiates design improvement, and resolves design and implementation issues.
Performs Mechanical Simulation Engineering tasks, including creating mechanical finite-element model geometry and meshing with parametric scripting, developing material models from measured material characterization, executing and post-processing simulation static or transient solutions that accounts for system boundary conditions, manufacturing process steps, and reliability stress conditions.
Mechanical simulation structures can scale from silicon, packaging, PCBs, device system to multiple systems.
Executes tolerance analysis from component level to board and system level. Collaborates with thermal engineers, electromechanical engineers, industrial designers, and other system engineers to optimize the design parameters, deliver performance objectives, and partner with external vendors through initial conceptual studies, layout, design, fabrication, assembly, debugging, and validation.
Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum qualifications and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your schoolwork, classes, research, relevant previous job, and/or internship experiences.
Minimum Qualifications
Must be perusing a master's degree in mechanical Engineer or relevant field with 1 year of hands-on experience in domain with demonstrated skills gained through internships academic projects coursework or hands-on training.
Experience listed above should be in any the following:
Proficiency in 3D modeling and AutoCAD.
Knowledge of design for manufacturing (DFM) principles.
Understanding of mechanical design fundamentals and hardware design.
Understanding of reliability and thermal principles in mechanical systems.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong problem-solving and group collaboration skills.
Effective communication skills for cross-functional teamwork.
Ability to innovate and adapt mechanical designs for diverse applications.
GPA: 3.0
We welcome individuals who are eager to contribute to impactful projects and grow their careers in mechanical design engineering. Join us to help shape Intel's mechanical solutions that drive innovation and create meaningful outcomes.
Job Type:
Student / Intern
Shift:
Shift 1 (United States of America)
Primary Location:
US, Oregon, Hillsboro
Additional Locations:
US, Arizona, Phoenix

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.

N/A
Benefits
We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel .
Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $89,098.00-89,102.00 USD

Our standard internship rates are based on your degree, location, and the job role. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location and job role during the hiring process.

postings.title: 2027 Intern - Communications
postings.description:
The Opportunity
We are seeking an individual passionate about communications to join and support Adobe’s Communications team. This role presents an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in public relations and communications by collaborating cross-functionally to tell the stories behind Adobe's creative products including Firefly, Photoshop, Premiere, and more. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a world-class team and contribute to communications that reach millions globally.
What You’ll Do
Build your network by attending various meetings to understand our priorities, the business, and the role of communications.
Shadow and support the team with product announcements, speaking opportunities, and media interactions.
Contribute to the development of press materials and messaging, bringing Adobe’s product and audience stories to life.
Help drive and monitor coverage and trends to inform communications strategies.
Work together with interdisciplinary teams to assist on important projects.
What You Need to Succeed
Currently enrolled full time and pursuing a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in communications, public relations, journalism, or a related field. Graduation is expected between December 2027 and June 2028.
Ability to participate in a full time internship between May and September 2027
A curious, approach to learning and development.
Strong writing and communication skills.
Capability to operate autonomously as well as collaborate with cross-functional groups.
Attention to detail and a proactive, problem-solving attitude.
About Adobe
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Internship Details
Location: Paris, France
Duration: 6 months
Start date: 1st May 2027
End date: 31st October 2027
Salary: € 2833 per month
Ready to jumpstart your career and delve into the tech industry?
Join Adobe as an Intern and dive into an experience that’s all about learning, growing, and making an impact. This isn’t just an internship, it’s your gateway into the world of cutting-edge technology, innovation, creativity and learning how a global company operates behind the scenes, you’ll gain real-world insights and hands-on experience that will set you up for success.
Plus, you’ll be part of an award-winning culture where creativity, collaboration, and growth are at the heart of everything we do.
Number of open roles: 1 Internship position available
Eligibility: Open to all BAC+5 // Masters 2 students who are looking for an end of studies internship and graduating in 2027
Hybrid: 3 days per week in the office, 2 days per week work from home
About the team:
You’ll be joining an established and diverse Solutions Consulting (SC) team in one of the World’s best workplaces and working with some exceptional people to help Adobe build a strong vibrant brand! A strong passion for digital transformation projects is a prerequisite for any of these roles. The Solutions Consulting Program is a comprehensive experience designed to introduce university students to a career in leveraging all digital transformation ecosystems.
You will interact with our presales, sales, solution specialists, and marketing teams in order to generate impactful content to transform opportunities to wins.
What you will do :
Automate and accelerate on Customer-specific material
Identify and produce Customer Journeys
Support custom demos
Create / develop specific web pages (POVs, post meeting follow-ups, tech case summary)
Produce videos related to the sales cycle
During your time at Adobe, you will be part of a Solutions Consulting team and work on real client & internal opportunities. Upon completion of the program, you will be developed in many of the areas required to be successful as a pre-sales consultant with a large range of tools around 360° business understanding and will be prepared for a potential career in the ﬁeld. As a member of our Solutions Consulting Program, based in Paris, you will work to develop professional skills that are essential to becoming an Adobe Solutions Consultant. You will be assigned to the SC team in order to work with all types of customer contexts.
What you need to succeed :
Fluent in English and French
Masters students (Bac +5) in Engineering, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent degree. Ideally a combination of both technical and business subjects.
Good understanding & designing capabilities on Customer applicative & technical architectures, as a support to your presales colleagues
Good understanding of security/cloud ecosystem for technical discussions
Have good interpersonal and presentation skills, enjoy working in a group setting and collaborating with others
Possess the ability to listen, dissect and tackle business needs
Be a curious self-starter who is resourceful and learns fast
Pay attention to detail with organizational skills
Enjoy challenges and learning about industry and technology trends
Must have high ethics, integrity, and humility
